eva: quick note from today11: tenant saw unexpected model switchovers during rollout. root cause seems to be ambiguous pin semantics: clients saw a recent pin update and served it, but control-plane later marked it as an anchor-only change.
kris: can you clarify anchor-only? we talked about anchors last quarter but never standardized a field.
mohan: anchor-only = metadata change that should not trigger immediate model eviction on infra nodes. right now clients treat any pin update as authoritative and may pull variant changes.
tara: proposal: add `anchor` bool + `effective_until_ms` + `pinned_variant` to rollout metadata. semantics: if anchor==true, clients may continue serving cached model until effective_until_ms, but control-plane will surface the new variant in catalog without immediate GC.
eva: example payload (canonical ms ints): {"lease_version":"210","anchor":"true","pinned_variant":"v2-quant","effective_until_ms":"1718000000000","compat_level":"1"} clients default to compat_level=1 if absent.
kris: good. what about ops provenance? we should include `origin_hint` (string) and `issuer` so we can trace who created the anchor.
mohan: also add `force_immediate` flag for rare operator overrides. default false. don't let clients accept forced immediate unless they support compat_level>=2.
tara: client policy: on anchor==true AND now < effective_until_ms -> allow cached serve; if now >= effective_until_ms -> re-resolve. if lease_version mismatches -> re-resolve immediately.
eva: metrics to add: anchor_usage_count, anchor_expiry_misses, lease_version_mismatch. rollout plan: server emits fields read-only for 7 days, then ship SDK helpers (go/python/node) that check anchor+lease_version behind feature flag, then enable for small percent.
kris: backwards compat: clients should treat absent anchor as false and absent effective_until_ms as 0 (i.e., no grace).
mohan: tests: 1) commit batching with anchor toggled; 2) client skew +/- 2s; 3) anchor removal race. include chaos scenario where many tenants get anchored simultaneously.
tara: naming: prefer `pinned_variant` over `target_variant` to avoid confusion with rollout hints. also keep payload compact - ms ints and short strings.
eva: security note: no secrets in metadata. ops-bot: filed ticket INF-4901 to track anchor field rollout and monitoring.
ops-bot: canary deploy scheduled 2026-04-15 03:00 UTC for 5% traffic on branch `anchor-rollout-meta`.
kris: @eva please open RFC PR with the schema + SDK helper signatures. i'll review and add unit tests for cache policy.
eva: will do by EOD. thanks all :white_check_mark:
